sources.entry: Stump - A fast, free and open source comics, manga and digital book server with OPDS support. (Source Code) MIT Rust

summary.one_liner: Stump is a free, open source server for comics, manga, and digital books, with OPDS support, built with Rust, Axum, SeaORM, and React.
summary.what_it_does: Stump serves a library of comics, manga, and e-books over the web. It supports EPUB, PDF, CBZ/ZIP, and CBR/RAR files, and includes built-in readers for each format. It exposes OPDS v1.2 (including OPDS PSE) and v2.0 feeds so OPDS-compatible reader apps can browse it. The README also lists EPUB annotations and highlights, OIDC authentication, multi-user accounts with permissions and age restrictions, several built-in themes, and Kobo and KoReader sync. Translations are handled through Weblate.
use_cases: Self-host a comic and manga library
Serve e-books to OPDS-compatible reader apps
Read EPUB, PDF, CBZ, and CBR files in a browser
Sync reading progress to Kobo or KoReader devices
Manage shared library access for multiple users
how_to_run: Install via Docker or a pre-built binary (see the documentation's installation guides)
notable: OPDS v1.2 (with PSE) and v2.0 catalog support
Built-in readers for EPUB, PDF, CBZ/ZIP, and CBR/RAR
Multi-user accounts with permissions and age restrictions
Monorepo with web UI, desktop (Tauri), and Expo mobile apps
caveats: Beta software until a stable 1.0 release; breaking changes are avoided but not guaranteed
Developed in the maintainer's free time with no guaranteed timeline for features or fixes
Detailed installation and usage guides are in external documentation, not the README
summary.license: MIT (repository-level; the expo app is GPL-3.0 and the wifi-ssid native module is MPL-2.0)
